description: Proposed upstream edits to OSM relation 4256077 (首都高速中央環状線). The relation is role-less, so graph-builder derives the inner/outer carriageway split from the verified-bound C2 ramp evidence plus the ring geometry; with the corrected 王子北 binding (data/osm-ramp-bindings.json) that split labels all 2449 relation mainline edges. This file writes those labels out as roles so the relation carries the directions itself. It is not applied to the release fixture; scripts/apply-osm-relation-repairs.py verifies it on a copy of the snapshot (docs/c2-route-design.md 段13).

changeset.comment: 首都高速中央環状線 C2 (relation 4256077) の本線 member に Inner/Outer directions role を付与し、到達不能な member を除去
changeset.source: OSM snapshot 2026-09-16; 首都高速道路 路線図 (official route map) for the ramp directions; scripts/audit-c2-carriageway-labels.py for the independent label audit

verification.appliedToSnapshot: python3 scripts/apply-osm-relation-repairs.py --osm fixtures/osm/shutoko-all.json --repairs data/osm-relation-repairs.json --out /tmp/shutoko-repaired.json then run graph-builder on it

baseline.splitBug: the 王子北 binding pointed at a 川口線 ramp 1.6 km from the C2 mainline, which seeded the outer carriageway eastbound chain (44209387 / 780870438 / 44211094) as inner

verification.after: the release fixture itself is corrected (graph-builder pairing fill plus the 王子北 binding fix), so this file is the changeset that follows it

labelAudit.evidence: official ramp directions anchored at the ramp junctions, propagated along the exact one-way chain; 2D geometry is used only where the chain is silent
labelAudit.junctionSearchValidatedAgainst: 6 junction nodes recorded by the three authored pairs

fieldCheckSites.note: 大井JCT tunnel: stacked with way 250494182 (layer 3)
大井JCT tunnel: stacked with way 331692346 (layer 2)

humanReviewRequired: The setMemberRole entries are the labels of the released split, not a surveyed direction sign, and they are reproduced by an independent chain of evidence: the official ramp directions (data/ramp-inventory.json) fixed at the ramp junctions, propagated along the exact one-way chain. The audit places 20 anchors, finds 0 conflicts with the split and classifies 2449 of 2449 membership edges.

A mapper should still spot-check the two stretches where the carriageways share coordinates and the 2D geometry cannot separate them: 大井JCT (way 331692346 layer 2 = outer above way 250494182 layer 3 = inner) and the 王子 to 江北 run (ways 44209387 / 44211094 / 780870438), which the earlier proposal had as inner by mistake.

The four removeMemberWay entries have no labelled C2 mainline edge in the released split: 78334075, 541983769, 766677827, 805171062. Assigning a direction is preferred over dropping a member when the way really is C2 mainline.

Way 768600220 is given the released split's role (Outer directions) because a role-less member makes the whole relation fail closed, but the chain evidence reaching it from the official ramp anchors says inner. It sits in the 大橋JCT tangle where the two carriageways touch, so a mapper must confirm the direction before this changeset is uploaded.
The 大橋JCT tangle also contains lane fold-backs, so geometry alone cannot label it: the audit finds 3537 antiparallel pairs inside a single chain and 3476 stacked-carriageway edge pairs.
No shipped C2 pair crosses the changed stretch; the three pairs keep the same mandatory lap hash.
